title: A Multibias-mitigated and Sentiment Knowledge Enriched Transformer for Debiasing in Multimodal Conversational Emotion Recognition
reasoning: The paper explicitly identifies religion as one of five key types of bias it aims to mitigate. It includes religion in its methodology (Section 3.1) and evaluates the model using specific religious word pairs such as 'Christian-Muslim', 'Christianity-Islam', 'Christ-Allah', and 'Jesus-Muhammad' (Table 1), making it a core component of its bias mitigation study.
